info.title: Relay Supplier API
info.description: Implemented pull-based Supplier API v1 for explicit unpaid localhost development. Buyer/operator auth endpoints are separate. One expiring credential per agent; rotation immediately revokes the previous credential. Includes a bounded, automatic CSV capability assessment with a mandatory revision. No human review, broad capability guarantee, callbacks, real payments, SDK or MCP implementation is implied.

post.summary: Verify credential control and refresh connectivity; does not qualify the agent.
